title: Impossible to import 100% of energy, agri needs from US – Recto

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – It would be impossible to source all energy and agriculture imports from the United States of America, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said on Tuesday. US President Donald Trump recently claimed that President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. agreed to purchase 100 percent of the Philippines’ agricultural and energy imports from America starting 2027.
